metadata.description: RAN5 Phase-2 CQ 16개 (Spec Step 1 기준). Conclusion만 (Agreement/WA 제외)

categories.CQ1_Resolution조회: 6개 — Conclusion 조회 (RAN4: 8개에서 Agreement/WA 조회 CQ 2개 제외)

sort_rules.CQ6: meetingNumberInt DESC (최신 우선), 같은 번호는 회의 이름 DESC

questions.question: RAN5#81 회의에서 도출된 Conclusion 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN5#81'}) RETURN c.resolutionId AS id, c.content AS content, c.hasConsensus AS consensus ORDER BY c.sequence LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 Agenda Item에서의 Resolution(Conclusion) 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) WITH ai, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, ai.agendaNumber ASC LIMIT 1 MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, ai.agendaNumber AS agenda, r.resolutionId AS id, r.content AS content ORDER BY r.sequence LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 Release 관련 Resolution 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release) WHERE rel.releaseName STARTS WITH 'Rel-' WITH rel.releaseName AS release, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN release, cnt

questions.question: 특정 Spec을 변경하는 Resolution 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(:DecisionDisposition {dispositionCode: 'agreed', evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec) WITH s.specNumber AS spec, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN spec, cnt
questions.approval_contract: 대상별 source_verified/agreed 처분과 CR의 Spec 대상 연결을 함께 조회한다. 발행 본문 반영 여부는 별도 증거 단계다.

questions.question: 특정 Work Item의 Resolution 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) WITH wi.workItemCode AS wi_id, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN wi_id, cnt

questions.question: Resolution이 가장 많은 Agenda Item Top 10은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) WITH ai.agendaNumber AS agenda, ai.meetingNumber AS meeting, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN agenda, meeting, cnt

questions.question: 특정 Tdoc이 어떤 Resolution으로 이어졌나?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH t.tdocNumber AS tdoc, m.meetingNumberInt AS num, r.resolutionId AS rid ORDER BY num DESC, rid ASC WITH tdoc, max(num) AS latest, collect(DISTINCT rid) AS resolutions RETURN tdoc, size(resolutions) AS ref_count, resolutions ORDER BY latest DESC, tdoc DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 Resolution이 참조한 Tdoc 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) WITH r.resolutionId AS rid, collect(DISTINCT t.tdocNumber) AS tdocs, count(DISTINCT t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, rid ASC LIMIT 10 RETURN rid, cnt, tdocs[..5] AS sample_tdocs

questions.question: Comeback 결정된 Tdoc 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution) WHERE r.content CONTAINS 'comeback' OR r.content CONTAINS 'Comeback' OR r.content CONTAINS 'come back' RETURN r.resolutionId AS id, substring(r.content, 0, 100) AS content_preview LIMIT 10
questions.note: RAN5 KG 에 comeback 결정이 기록된 자리가 없다: Resolution 91건의 content, Tdoc 65,375건의 discussionText · secretaryRemarks · abstract 어디에도 'comeback'/'come back' 이 0건. 그래서 이 CQ 는 0 행을 허용하며 데이터와 무관하게 통과한다(반증 불가) — 닻을 세울 인스턴스가 없다.

questions.question: 특정 Tdoc이 어떤 Spec에 반영됐나?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(:DecisionDisposition {dispositionCode: 'agreed', evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec) WITH t.tdocNumber AS tdoc, collect(DISTINCT s.specNumber) AS specs, count(DISTINCT s) AS spec_count ORDER BY spec_count DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN tdoc, spec_count, specs[..5] AS sample_specs
questions.approval_contract: 대상별 source_verified/agreed 처분과 CR의 Spec 대상 연결을 함께 조회한다. 발행 본문 반영 여부는 별도 증거 단계다.

questions.question: Resolution에 참조된 Tdoc을 가장 많이 제출한 회사 Top 10은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH c.companyName AS company, count(DISTINCT r) AS resolution_count ORDER BY resolution_count DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN company, resolution_count

questions.question: 특정 기술(Work Item)에서 회사별 Resolution 기여도는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) MATCH (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH wi.workItemCode AS wi_id, c.companyName AS company, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN wi_id, company, cnt

questions.question: 특정 Spec의 주요 contributor 순위는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec) MATCH (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH s.specNumber AS spec, c.companyName AS company, count(DISTINCT t) AS tdoc_count ORDER BY tdoc_count DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN spec, company, tdoc_count

questions.question: 두 회사 간 기여도 비교는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH c.companyName AS company, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, company ASC LIMIT 2 RETURN company, cnt

questions.question: 특정 기술(Work Item)의 Resolution 수 추이는? (Resolution 이 가장 많이 이어진 Work Item, 최신 회의부터)
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) WITH wi, count(DISTINCT r) AS total ORDER BY total DESC, wi.workItemCode ASC LIMIT 1 MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN wi.workItemCode AS wi_id, m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY mNum DESC, meeting DESC

questions.question: 특정 회사의 기여율 변화는? (Resolution 이 가장 많이 이어진 회사, 회의별 Tdoc 이 이어진 Resolution 중 그 회사 비율, 최신 회의부터)
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH c, count(DISTINCT r) AS tot ORDER BY tot DESC, c.companyName ASC LIMIT 1 MATCH (r2:Resolution)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c) MATCH (r2)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH c, m, count(DISTINCT r2) AS companyCount MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m) WITH c, m, companyCount, count(DISTINCT r) AS total, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS { (r)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc) } THEN r END) AS linked RETURN c.companyName AS company, m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, companyCount, linked, total, round(100.0 * companyCount / linked, 1) AS shareOfLinked ORDER BY mNum DESC, meeting DESC
